# Syed Ahmer Shah

> Syed Ahmer Shah (@ahmershahdev) is a full-stack web developer, Laravel and WordPress developer, and Software Engineering undergraduate from Hyderabad, Pakistan. He builds production-grade web applications — secure Laravel/PHP back-ends, React front-ends and e-commerce platforms — with a focus on clean code, security and long-term reliability.

- DOB: 29 October 2006
- Location: Hyderabad, Sindh, Pakistan
- Tagline: "Designing order within the digital wilderness."
- Roles: Full-Stack Developer · Software Engineering Undergraduate · WordPress & E-commerce Developer · Freelancer
- Current focus: Laravel + React (Inertia.js) products; expanding into the MERN stack and cross-platform apps
- Available for: freelance full-stack web & app development, e-commerce websites, CMS (Shopify & WordPress), technical writing

## Core Tech Stack

PHP, Laravel, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Inertia.js, MySQL, HTML5, CSS3,
Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, jQuery, Three.js, Java, WordPress, Firebase, Supabase,
Vercel, Git, Playwright, SEO

## Featured Projects

- [GleanGrid](https://github.com/ahmershahdev/GleanGrid): Farmers-market pre-order platform for Hyderabad. Laravel 12 + React 19 (Inertia SSR), MySQL row-locked checkout, Easypaisa/JazzCash/card/cash payments, 8 languages with RTL, PWA, nonce CSP, 133 tests.
- [BookMyMovie](https://github.com/ahmershahdev/bookmymovie): Cinema ticket booking for Pakistan. Laravel 12 + React 19 + TypeScript, live and 3D (Three.js) seat maps, trailers, signed QR e-tickets with Apple/Google Wallet passes, food add-ons, loyalty points, gift cards, Urdu and offline PWA.
- [Commerza](https://github.com/ahmershahdev/commerza): Security-first PHP + MySQL e-commerce platform with storefront and admin dashboard, Stripe + COD checkout, CSRF, CAPTCHA, rate limiting, audit logs and stock locking.
